entities.name: Vicent Marzà i Ibàñez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vicent Marzà i Ibáñez is a Valencian teacher and politician, member of the Valencian Parliament for Compromís and member of Més–Compromís. Between 2015 and 2022 he was Minister of Education, Research, Culture and Sports of the Generalitat Valenciana.
